ws_scheduling_rules.title: Scheduling Rules
values: Contact marked 'Out of Office' in CRM notes
Register their designated delegate instead (listed in delegate_email field on the contact)
Contact has 'Do Not Invite' in CRM notes
Skip entirely - do not register or substitute
Require waiting room enabled on Zoom meeting
More than 3 external attendees requested for a single meeting
Register only top 3 by title seniority (VP > Director > Senior Manager > Manager > Other). Do not register overflow attendees.
